description: Source code implementing WAN interface policy management and state machine for auto WAN selection, scanning, teardown, reconfiguration, and reboot handling in a network device.

methods.name: WanMgr_RdkBus_AddAllIntfsToLanBridge
methods.description: Adds all interfaces to LAN bridge based on group and interface data.

methods.name: isLastActiveLinkFromSysCfg
methods.description: Checks if the given interface is the last active link based on system configuration.

methods.name: setActiveLinkToSysCfg
methods.description: Sets the active link in system configuration based on current active interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetActiveLink
methods.description: Sets the ActiveLink flag in interface data and persists in PSM.

methods.name: WanMgr_GetPrevSelectedInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the previously selected active interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_Policy_Auto_GetHighPriorityIface
methods.description: Selects the highest priority interface that is enabled and disabled.

methods.name: WanMgr_UpdateControllerData
methods.description: Updates the WAN policy controller data from current configuration and interface data.

methods.name: WanMgr_ResetActiveLinkOnAllIface
methods.description: Resets ActiveLink flag on all interfaces to FALSE.

methods.name: WanMgr_ResetGroupSelectedIface
methods.description: Resets the group's selected interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_ResetIfaceTable
methods.description: Resets interfaces marked as invalid to disabled.

methods.name: WanMgr_CheckIfSelectedIfaceOnlyPossibleWanLink
methods.description: Checks if the currently selected interface is the only possible WAN link.

methods.name: Transition_Start
methods.description: Initial transition to start WAN interface selection process.

methods.name: Transition_InterfaceSelected
methods.description: Handles transition when an interface is selected but not validated.

methods.name: Transition_InterfaceInvalid
methods.description: Handles transition when interface validation fails.

methods.name: Transition_TryingNextInterface
methods.description: Attempts to select the next highest priority interface.

methods.name: Transition_InterfaceFound
methods.description: Handles transition when an interface is found to be PHY UP.

methods.name: Transition_InterfaceDeselect
methods.description: Handles transition when interface PHY is DOWN.

methods.name: Transition_InterfaceValidated
methods.description: Handles transition when interface is validated successfully.

methods.name: Transition_RestartSelectionInterface
methods.description: Handles transition to restart interface selection process.

methods.name: Transition_ReconfigurePlatform
methods.description: Handles transition to reconfigure platform and reboot if needed.

methods.name: Transition_AutoWanTearDown
methods.description: Handles transition to tear down WAN policy.

methods.name: Transition_ActivatingInterface
methods.description: Transitions to active WAN interface state.

methods.name: Transition_ResetSelectedInterface
methods.description: Stops WAN VISM and transitions to tear down state.

methods.name: Transition_RebootDevice
methods.description: Triggers device reboot.

methods.name: State_SelectingInterface
methods.description: State where interface selection is initiated.

methods.name: State_ScanningInterface
methods.description: State where interface scanning and validation occurs.

methods.name: State_WaitingForIfaceTearDown
methods.description: State waiting for interface teardown to complete.

methods.name: State_InterfaceReconfiguration
methods.description: State to reconfigure interfaces and hardware settings.

methods.name: State_RebootingPlatform
methods.description: State to reboot platform after hardware reconfiguration.

methods.name: State_WanInterfaceActive
methods.description: State when WAN interface is active.

methods.name: State_WaitingForInterfaceSMExit
methods.description: State waiting for interface state machine to exit.

methods.name: WanMgr_AutoWanSelectionProcess
methods.description: Main thread function managing WAN auto-selection state machine.
